title: The late-1940s band; Jo leaves, Shadow Wilson falls ill
summary: Dance reads personnel for 1947-49; Greene recalls Butch Ballard and Shadow's illness.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Then when you get to '50 Basie breaks up --

Yeah, but, so what I'm really saying is this -- times changed for big bands, didn't they -- after the war -- and so on. But, so -- all I was really saying is in '46 we get the rhythm section back, etcetera and it's a very fine band --
Mm hmm.
-- and it's like that for at least a couple of years.
Mm hmm.
Then -- so -- then times are getting hard to keep a big band working -- that's the point, isn't it?
Yeah.
So in '50 he breaks up. But, I would like to know, you know, in '47, '48, '49 -- who all was in that band before that band broke up.
Do you have that?
Yeah, well, I mean -- I've been reading these off. I mean -- it's the same thing.
All these different replacements?
Yeah. You know, I mean the tenors keep changing --
Mm hmm.
-- and the trumpets are more or less the same.
Mm hmm.
And, you know, Walter Page and Jo Jones are there again.
Mm hmm.
They're there in '47, '48. Now in '48 you get Singleton Palmer --
On bass.
-- on bass, and Shadow Wilson.
Mm hmm.
Mm hmm.
Yeah.
So, then Jo is gone then?
Mm hmm.
Well, do you -- can you remember why?
No.
Because that's what I never knew.
No, I can't -- I don't know why he left during that period.
Shadow wasn't with the band long because here we've got somebody called 'Butch' Ballard.
Yeah. Butch Ballard is out of Philadelphia. Shadow -- that's the period -- that's the time he got sick.
Shadow got sick?
Yeah.
What was his trouble?
I don't know. I don't remember.
He got sick and died?
Yeah. Now, what year is that?
Shadow is in there in '48.
And, now you've got -- Buddy is gone. You've got Wardell Gray on tenor.
Mm hmm. Mm hmm.
Did Buddy leave to go with somebody or --
And, Clark Terry.
And, Clark Terry. Was that the break?
Yeah.
Is that the big band or the small band.
Big band. That's just before the break-up.
-- the break-up. What happened to Buddy?
Yeah, that's right. But then there's somebody called "Weasel" Parker they've got listed (laugh). Who was he?
Tenor man.
Where was he from?
Where was Weasel from? Around Cleveland -- from Ohio.
